description: This file is a PHP template used for rendering the main extra section of a project page in a crowdfunding or project management platform. It generates HTML with embedded PHP to display project details, sharing options, matchers, call info, rewards, and navigation tabs based on the project's data.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Represents the project being displayed, including properties like id, name, location, type, status, call info, rewards, and sign URL.

classes.name: Matcher
classes.description: Represents a matcher object used to match project funding with external sources, including methods to calculate contributions and retrieve matching rewards.

methods.name: get_url
methods.description: Returns the base URL of the current request or project page.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Retrieves a localized text string for labels and headers.

methods.name: t
methods.description: Translates or retrieves a specific text key, likely for localization.

methods.name: asset
methods.description: Returns the URL for asset images or files.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Includes and renders a PHP partial/template file.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Determines the current active tab or section to highlight in navigation.
